title: Per-request response size cap enforced after actual read, not only Content-Length header
description: client.rs and blob.rs: All four HTTP paths check Content-Length as fast-path AND re-check bytes.len() after actual read. A contributor might remove the post-read check as redundant. It is not: Content-Length can lie (chunked responses, server bugs, hostile servers). The post-read check is the actual security control; the header check is an optimization. Both checks are necessary. Defend both.
